meta.name: CabinLight
meta.description: Cabin light. Supports switching on and off and adjusting brightness. When on, it changes the illuminance of its Space according to its brightness.

power.description: Whether the cabin light is powered on.

brightness.description: Cabin light brightness as an integer percentage. The setting persists while powered off.

get_brightness.description: Return the brightness percentage. The cabin light must be powered on.

brightness.description: Current brightness as an integer percentage from 0 through 100.

errorcodes.POWER_OFF: The cabin light must be powered on to read brightness.

set_brightness.description: Set brightness to an integer percentage from 0 through 100. The cabin light must be powered on. Invalid input or an unmet power precondition leaves state unchanged.

errorcodes.POWER_OFF: The cabin light must be powered on to change brightness.
errorcodes.INVALID_INPUT_ERROR: Brightness must be an integer from 0 through 100.

set_power.description: Set power and dependent property access. While off, every non-power property is inaccessible through public getters/setters. Turning on restores access. A property marked auto_reset resets only when turning on.

after_action.description: When powered on, contribute illuminance to the containing Space equal to the brightness value in lux. When powered off, contribute zero illuminance. Repeated updates replace the previous contribution rather than accumulating it.

effect_properties.name: power
effect_properties.description: Determines whether the light contributes illuminance.

effect_properties.name: brightness
effect_properties.description: Determines the illuminance contribution while the light is powered on.
